name: Example Agent API
description: Creates, configures and runs AI agents on behalf of callers, and reports on their executions. A2A v1.0 AgentCard with OAuth 2.0 client credentials.

skills.name: Create Agent
skills.description: Create a new AI agent with a specified configuration, model and tools.
examples: Create an agent named 'Support Analyzer' to analyze support tickets for priority and sentiment
Create a lightweight agent for quick customer inquiries with a maximum of 10 steps

skills.name: List Agents
skills.description: Retrieve a paginated list of agents with filtering and sorting.
examples: List agents created in the last 7 days, starting with the most recent

skills.name: Run Agent
skills.description: Execute an agent with input data and stream its progress until it finishes.
examples: Run the Support Analyzer agent on ticket SUP-12345
Execute the Quick Responder with a customer message and wait up to 2 minutes

skills.name: Monitor Execution
skills.description: Check the status of an agent execution and retrieve its results when complete.
examples: Check the status of execution abc123
Get the results of the last run of the Support Analyzer

skills.name: Update Agent
skills.description: Modify an agent's configuration, name, tools or settings.
examples: Update the Support Analyzer agent to use a smaller model
Add the 'email_send' tool to the Support Analyzer and increase max_steps to 25
